items.description: When paying at a DAISO store, show the barcode in your coupon box to the store staff to use it

You can use it until the balance is fully spent
within the validity period

sections.title: How to use
sections.description:
[DAISO stores]
Present the gift card when paying, or use a self-checkout counter
(Select DAISO gift card > Scan the items > Scan the barcode or enter the number > Pay)

[DAISO online store]
At checkout, enter the amount to use under "DAISO gift card" > Pay (available after registering the gift card)

sections.title: Usage information
sections.description:
Please be sure to check the list of available stores before use.
This is a deducting-balance gift card that can be used multiple times within its remaining balance.
If your purchase exceeds the gift card amount, you can pay the difference by card, cash, or another method.
Points can be earned when paying with the gift card.
Products purchased with the gift card can be exchanged or returned within the validity period.
Available stores: https://www.daisogift.co.kr/usestoreinfo

sections.title: Changes and cancellation
sections.description: If the voucher has not been used, you can receive a 100% refund within the validity period. Refunds are not available after the validity period has passed or if the voucher has been partially used.

sections.title: Precautions
sections.description: The exchange validity period is 60 days from the purchase date. (Validity periods may differ for seasonal products, corporate gifts (B2B), and discounted products.)
